text:
Sam: Quick follow-up from today's console-arch sync — need to finalize ownership split between control-plane authz and query-side caching/prefetch. Sketch below.
Julia: +1. main risk is stale cached perms causing a leak during rollout.
Omar: Can we make the control plane canonical for perm decisions and have query nodes do local validation using a signed short-lived token? Keeps logic central.
Priya: That will add RTT for first requests though — do we have ballpark numbers? :thinking_face: 
Sam: Rough numbers from the prototype: control-plane authz sign ~4ms median, query cache hit saves ~12ms. So a cache miss + control check is ~4ms extra vs baseline. Still within our 50ms interactive SLO for most dashboards.
Julia: Proposal: control-plane owns canonical authz and issues signed tokens with a perm-version id; query nodes validate tokens locally and maintain a small prefetch cache keyed by tenant+perm-version. Token TTL=30s to bound staleness.
Omar: +1. We also need anti-entropy: control-plane emits perm-version diffs and a reconciliation queue so query nodes eventually converge if they miss an update.
Sam: Rollout config sketch: 
```
console.config.authz.ownership = "control-plane"
console.config.authz.token_ttl = 30
console.config.authz.reconcile_interval = 15
```
Julia: Rollout plan idea: 1) default off in staging, 2) enable for 10% tenant ring with enhanced telemetry, 3) expand to 50% then global. Monitor token_validation.failures and authz.cache.staleness.
Priya: Also watch 95th latency on dashboard initial load and cache-miss rate. If validation adds tail latency we need a fallback fast-path.
Omar: I can own query-side: token validation, local cache, reconcile loop, and a compatibility shim for older nodes.
Sam: I'll own control-plane signer + metrics + the event diff stream. We'll need a small schema extension on perm events: perm_version, tombstone flag, and monotonic nonce.
Omar: I'll add a light-weight circuit breaker: if token validation fails >X/min then fall back to immediate control-plane sync for that tenant.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: authz-token-signer -> staging at 2026-03-24T02:00Z
Priya: Add metrics: `authz.token_validation.failures`, `authz.cache.stale_reconciliations`, `authz.token_latency_ms` and a tenant-level tag.
Sam: Agreed. I will open a short RFC follow-up doc with sequence diagrams and perf targets (50ms median, 95th < 120ms for initial load). Will call out invariant: control-plane is the source of truth, query nodes are transient caches.
Julia: Nice. One more thing — let's add a chaos test that replays perm revocations mid-request to validate no leakage.
Sam: Good call. I'll include a test plan. Thanks all :thumbsup:
